title: HF2498 (2021-2022 Regular): Dangerous weapon possession prohibited in the Capitol complex, and permit to carry holder exception to crime of carrying rifles and shotguns in public places eliminated.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-04-09; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/HF/2498/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced (as filed). Section 1 strikes the references to the commissioner of public safety in the exceptions and the notice rule for permit holders; section 2 strikes the clause that excluded permit holders from "carry" (old clause (3)). Struck text is not quoted. Section 1 paragraph (a) is existing law as amended; the change is that the Capitol Area clause now has no commissioner consent route.
